rulings.evidence: "Fresh" here means freshly ground, a grinder instruction and not a form flip, exactly as 'freshly ground black pepper' -> black-pepper was ruled 2026-08-26; the Bell Pepper near-misses are keyword collisions on 'pepper'. Board carries black-pepper 7 of 7, so a REUSE.

Sliced fresh tomato, so the canned diced-tomatoes and dried near-misses are refused as form flips; roma is the standard whole-tomato shelf SKU and not a variety premium like cherry or romaine, so the board's fresh `tomatoes` id (7 of 7, 0.95 Aldi) is the same product and price class.
